text: I have treated the town's herds since I was apprenticed to my aunt.
Roka and I decide together when a herd needs to move to new ground.
Cattle grazed near the Old Canal Bed fall ill more often than any other pasture.
I've tracked this pattern for over a decade now.
I cannot fully explain why. The water there looks the same as anywhere else.
Kiri notices these patterns almost as quickly as I do, without formal training.
I'm teaching her properly now, so her instinct has a method behind it.
I suspect the illness pattern began around the same years as the Turning.
Bran's kiln-boundary and Doran's terrace troubles seem to circle the same ground I avoid for grazing.
I think something about that stretch of land changed permanently, not just the river's course.
I reported the pattern to Tarek years ago. He listened, then nothing changed.
I don't think he dismissed it out of malice. I think he didn't know what to do with it.
The archive-keeper was the only official-adjacent person who took my records seriously.
She asked to see my illness maps. I gave her copies.
She didn't promise to fix anything. She just said the information mattered. That was enough.
I still keep the herds off that ground whenever I can manage it.
